lanes_not_run.audience-corrections: Live captures are our own terminal and browser recordings; no audience exists to correct them.

segments.title: jet dev captured end to end: new web template, dev app probe, edit cycle, syntax/type/runtime errors, handler panic, port conflict, keys, flags, build
Vite 8.3.5 captured: create-vite React template, banner, h shortcuts, HMR with state kept, syntax overlay, blank runtime error, port fallback

mechanism-and-architecture.reason: Vite capture shows the WebSocket token URL but internal module graph architecture was not inspected.

expert-descent.reason: The Vite capture exercised default flags only, so expert configuration was not observed.

interop-and-portability.reason: The Vite capture ran on Linux Chromium only; cross-platform behavior was not captured.

reuse-and-anti-lessons.reason: The Vite create step pulled npm packages; dependency reuse lessons belong to the Next create capture.

segments.title: Next.js 16.4.5 Turbopack captured: create-next-app, banner with Network URL, request log with timing split, build and runtime overlays, EADDRINUSE

mechanism-and-architecture.reason: The Next capture used Turbopack defaults; on-demand route compile is claimed from the local development guide instead.

default-common-job.reason: The Next banner and request log already cover the default dev job in other claims.

cost-and-measurement.reason: Next timing and memory numbers are folded into the jet dev latency and memory comparison claims.

segments.title: Astro 7.4.5 captured: banner, request log, h shortcuts, full-page reload losing state, CompilerError overlay, already-running conflict message

cost-and-measurement.reason: Astro start and memory figures are folded into the jet dev comparison claims.

interop-and-portability.reason: Astro capture ran on Linux Chromium only; platform portability was not observed.

semantic-obligations.reason: Rsbuild overlay capture showed no correctness obligation beyond the shared overlay claim.

expert-descent.reason: Rsbuild capture used default config; server.setup middleware was not exercised.

interop-and-portability.reason: Rsbuild capture ran on Linux Chromium only; portability was not observed.

reuse-and-anti-lessons.reason: The Rsbuild create step gave no reusable lesson beyond the Next install weight claim.

default-common-job.reason: The Parcel default job is covered by the shared banner and overlay claims.

interop-and-portability.reason: Bun capture ran on Linux only; portability of the HMR socket was not observed.
